name: shadowsocks-c-d52ddf2b-blind30
instr:
# Repairing shadowsocks-c without a test suite

The repository has received 30 separate undocumented edits. The programs built here are meant to take a connection locally, work out whether the destination may be carried, and relay the traffic to a remote peer over a protected channel. Almost nothing along that path behaves any more.

It fails from the very first moment. Every one of the shipped executables aborts the instant it is launched, before anything is listening and before any work is done. Asking one of them for its version prints no version text, and the request is instead treated as an option nobody recognizes. Asking another to show the summary of what it accepts on the command line exits silently, printing nothing.

Telling a program where to connect goes wrong next. A stored settings file in which a remote endpoint is written without a port is no longer reported as incomplete; reading the file faults partway instead, and an endpoint whose port is spelled out in letters is taken as valid and left holding a meaningless value. Supplying that number as plain digits on its own is refused as not being a number at all, while digits with stray characters trailing them are accepted as a valid one.

Pasting in a share link fares no better. The password and the chosen method come back lifted from the wrong span of the text, or the link cannot be read at all. Breaking the address part of such a link into a name and a number returns the name with a character missing from one
